### 2. Facts to look up
### 3. Facts to derive

Here is the task:

You have one question to answer. It is paramount that you provide a correct answer.
Give it all you can: I know for a fact that you have access to all the relevant tools to solve it and find the correct answer (the answer does exist). Failure or 'I cannot answer' or 'None found' will not be tolerated, success will be rewarded.

errors.evidence: The LLM was tasked to evaluate the correctness of an answer given by a subordinate agent and provide a final answer. The LLM stated that "Based on the investigation from our managed search_agent, the 2015 paper \u201cPie Menus or Linear Menus, Which Is Better?\u201d was authored by Pietro Murano and Iram N. Khan. Although both authors had previous publications, Iram N. Khan\u2019s publication history shows that his earliest work appeared earlier\u2014namely \u201cInvestigations in Interface Usability\u201d from about 2011. Since the task asks for the title of the first paper authored by the one who had authored prior papers, the answer is \u201cInvestigations in Interface Usability.\u201d"
errors.description: The LLM assumed that the earliest publication by an author was the first paper authored by them without verifying the actual first paper authored by each author.
